Guillén Santángel: Guillén Barcelo Villalbas de Canales y Santángel

notes: Bare Cotado is ambiguous with Luzia's mother Blanca Cotado; Señorita Cotado is always Luzia. Bare de/De Paredes is almost always Víctor, but ancestor Tello de Paredes and Casa de Paredes (family) are dropped. Luzia's forged name Calderón and true middle name Cana appear only in full-name forms.
